request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Mithril Protocol continuous development and related Intersect administration costs.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ADA, consisting of 3,699,440 ADA for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ADA for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Mithril uses stake-based threshold multi-signatures to certify Cardano state in a trustless way, enabling nodes and applications to verify state rapidly without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal says Mithril lowers onboarding friction through faster sync times and can unlock tooling for exchanges, wallets, monitoring, bridges, light wallets, full wallets, and light clients.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, alone or in aggregate, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Audit and oversight costs are included in the overhead, and independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
Teragone has not previously received direct funding from Cardano treasury or community governance programs, while its Mithril work to date has been funded by IOG.

Intersect will use Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, one Project-Specific Smart Contract, specified on-chain addresses, and role-based authorization thresholds involving Intersect admins, Intersect leadership, and six oversight entities.
A dashboard at treasury.sundae.fi is available for the community to audit the TRSC or PSSC and track metrics related to the withdrawn ADA, with activity also verifiable on chain.

summary: The document describes a 3,810,423 ADA treasury withdrawal administered by Intersect for continued Mithril Protocol development, with stated budget breakdown, governance process references, NCL compliance assertion, smart-contract custody details, and oversight arrangements.
